card.name: Digits in section cross-references
card.fires_on: A digit inside a numbered section cross-reference such as (5.12) or (14.2), usually after a decimal point, in bracketed 'see Warnings and Precautions' pointers. Also a study number after the word Study.

modes.label: Section number reference
modes.description: Final digit of a section number inside a 'see Warnings and Precautions' or similar pointer.

modes.label: Study number
modes.description: A study number right after the word Study.
